articles.title: Former Liberal MP Nate Erskine-Smith to run for council seat in Beaches-East York
articles.summary: Former Liberal MP Nate Erskine-Smith will run for a Toronto city council seat in Beaches-East York in the October municipal election.

articles.title: 60-year-old man dead after e-scooter crash in North York: Toronto police
articles.summary: A driver of an e-scooter has died from his injuries after crashing into the open door of a parked vehicle in North York Sunday morning, Toronto police said.

articles.title: Montreal is hosting a final farewell for legendary jazz pianist Oliver Jones
articles.summary: Montrealers will get a chance to say goodbye to legendary jazz pianist Oliver Jones today. Montreal’s city hall is hosting a public viewing in the afternoon, while a public funeral service is scheduled for Thursday at Union United Church in his old neighbourhood of Little Burgundy. The award-winning pianist died July 22 at age 91 […]

articles.title: Tempo fall to Clark, Fever for 11th straight loss
articles.summary: Kelsey Mitchell led all scorers with 29 points as the Indiana Fever held on for a 101-95 win over the Toronto Tempo on Tuesday. Superstar Caitlin Clark had 24 points and seven assists as Indiana (25-13) won its fifth in a row. Dozens of fans at Scotiabank Arena wore Clark jerseys. articles.title: 'Just crazy to see': Toronto resident captures Zanzibar fire on video
articles.summary: A Toronto resident captured on video the huge fire at Zanzibar Tavern that gutted the adult entertainment nightclub on Yonge Street over the weekend.

articles.title: Nate Erskine-Smith joins Beaches—East York race before Toronto election filing deadline
articles.summary: There are now nearly a dozen candidates vying to be the next Ward 19 Beaches-East York councillor after Brad Bradford opted to run for mayor.

articles.title: Family of toddler who died in fall from North York highrise sues building owners, management
articles.summary: The family of a toddler who fell to her death from a highrise apartment in North York in May is suing the building owners and its management for millions in damages.

articles.title: Man charged after sexual assaults on Richmond Hill hiking trail: York police
articles.summary: York regional police say a 30-year-old man has been charged in two sexual assaults on youth victims that occurred days apart in Richmond Hill.

articles.title: Power being restored for thousands of Brampton homes and businesses after collision knocked down hydro poles
articles.summary: About 4,376 homes and businesses lost power for some time early Tuesday due to a single-vehicle collision that knocked down two hydro poles, the power company said.

articles.title: A year after her 8-year-old son was shot in his bed, a mother continues to fight against gun violence
articles.summary: After her son was struck and killed by a stray bullet while in their North York apartment, Holly Roy says she continues to carry him with her as she advocates against gun violence.
